title: Project configuration
description: Identity, layout, architecture profile and enabled integrations of this repository. This file is not a dependency manager: see .claude/rules/common/sources-of-truth.md.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema, for editor validation.

solutionName.description: Name of the solution and the prefix of every project name. Dots are allowed, because a dotted prefix such as Contoso.Orders is ordinary in .NET: the projects then become Contoso.Orders.Domain and so on.

rootNamespace.description: Root namespace of every project in the solution.

solutionFile.description: Solution file, relative to the repository root.

frontend.description: Directory holding the browser application, if this repository has one. Optional: when it is absent the frontend check stages report 'not configured'. When it is declared, a directory that is missing or whose dependencies are not installed is a failed stage, never a skipped one.

profile.description: layered: the built-in dependency direction is enforced. custom: layer-direction rules report themselves not applicable, while the dependency-cycle rules still run. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

language.description: BCP 47 language subtag for generated instructions and OpenSpec artifacts. Repository code and file names stay English regardless.

database.description: Persistence integration. 'none': the database stage reports not configured. 'postgres': the stage opens a connection and fails if the instance is unreachable.

deployment.description: Deployment integration. Only 'none' is implemented; a deployment stage reports 'not configured', never 'passed'.

default.description: Class assigned to a change whose class is not explicitly established. Only 'standard' is permitted, so triviality is always an explicit, argued exception.

allowTrivial.description: Whether the Trivial class may be used at all. Trivial still requires tests, review and CI.

enabled.description: Whether the archive gate runs. Disabling it is a policy decision, not a way to pass.

scope.description: repository: the default, requiring zero active changes repository-wide. pull-request: a documented, weaker extension limited to changes touched by the current pull request. See docs/change-workflow.md.

requireZeroActiveChanges.description: Whether the gate requires the active-change count in scope to be zero before the final merge.

pascalIdentifier.description: A single C# identifier: a letter or underscore followed by letters, digits or underscores.

relativePath.description: A forward-slash relative path inside the repository. Absolute paths, backslashes and parent traversal are rejected.
